integrity: The source premises were checked against the cited full texts. The new finite group-action step was reconstructed from the elliptic-curve group law and exhaustively replayed on the exact finite torsion module; no numerical sampling is used.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the complex Fermat cubic in its standard plane embedding and to its projective automorphism group. It does not assert the full automorphism group of the abstract incidence configuration and does not cover positive characteristic.
title: The \(81\) sextactic secants of the Fermat cubic split into \(9+18+54\) projective-symmetry orbits
